questions.stem: A guy was playing in a garden. Suddenly, he collapsed and was rushed to the hospital. His friend who played with him in the garden informed the doctors that he ate one of the fruits in the garden post which he seemed to have developed these symptoms. He also had irritability, restlessness, dry hot skin, and was unable to pass urine and stools. Identify the poison and its appropriate antidote.
questions.solutionHtml:
Datura, Physostigmine

Irritability, restlessness, dry hot skin, and being unable to pass urine and stools (antimuscarinic poison) after having a fruit is suggestive of dhatura poisoning .

An appropriate antidote for datura is Acetylcholinesterase Inhibitor Physostigmine.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 598.

questions.stem: Farmer sleeping in a farm during harvesting season, something bites him and he wakes up to see it crawl away. He is rushed to PHC, where the doctor notices an actively bleeding wound. Which of the following is responsible?
questions.solutionHtml:
Viper

Among the above options, Viper bite can cause an actively bleeding wound,with intense local reaction at the site of bite.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 563.

questions.stemHtml: An investigation team reaches a crime site where the team collects the trace evidence and sends it to the forensic laboratory, where a forensic expert sees "Yellow color needle shape crystals" in microscopy. What is the test?
questions.solutionHtml:
Barberios test

Among the above given options only Barberios test shows Yellow color needle shape crystals.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 434.

questions.stemHtml: A 45 years old man developed generalized muscle spasm and arching backwards as shown in the image. He had a history of consuming seeds a few days back. What is the toxin responsible for this abnormal posturing?
questions.solutionHtml:
Strychnine

Generalized muscle spasm and arching backwards (Opisthotonos) as shown in the image. with a history of consuming seeds pointing towards strychnine poisoning.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 612.
